resources.string: Fetch eligible instances from the official Invidious directory only when tapped. Nothing is selected or enabled automatically.

%1$s is operated by a third party and can see your requests. Availability can change. Selecting it saves it as the active instance but does not enable Invidious or trust separate media servers automatically. If Invidious is already enabled, the app will restart.
No currently healthy HTTPS instances in the official directory advertise API access. You can still enter a trusted instance manually.
Could not load the official Invidious directory. Check your connection and try again.
Add or remove trusted HTTPS instance URLs, one per line.
Choose a saved instance. Switching while Invidious is enabled restarts the app.

Send YouTube requests through your instance, including video and images. Direct YouTube requests are blocked. The instance must support the API and proxy media locally or through explicitly trusted media servers. Some YouTube features are unavailable. Changing this setting restarts the app.
HTTPS root URL of an instance you trust. Its operator can see your requests. Changing the instance while enabled restarts the app.
Enter the HTTPS root URL of an Invidious instance, without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.
The Invidious instance returned an unusable media or manifest response. Try again later or choose another trusted instance that supports video proxying.
The selected Invidious instance denied API access (HTTP %1$s). Choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance is rate limiting requests (HTTP %1$s). Try again later or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance is unavailable (HTTP %1$s). Try again later or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance rejected the request (HTTP %1$s). Check the instance address or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.

Optional Companion servers for the selected instance. Enter up to 16 HTTPS root URLs, one per line, only after verifying them with the instance operator. These operators can see media requests. Direct YouTube connections remain blocked. Changes while enabled restart the app.
Use up to 16 HTTPS root URLs without paths, credentials, queries or fragments. YouTube and Google media hosts are not allowed.
